bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
root=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
p="$root/.worktrees/ai-core-openrouter-consumer-20261128"
name=libral-vault-libral-vault-1
candidate=libral-vault:ai-core-openrouter-22fc6d11
backup=libral-vault:rollback-ai-core-openrouter-3e0c06d8
cd "$root"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3e0c06d81257fbbe8a35f024a5916f3b96f1e95e
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = 22fc6d11f40f8f684430dfe1fd4f03cac0f301b0
git fetch --no-tags origin main
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = a918bd682c2adddb16d6c8c7188f1019f2f17f3c
test "$(git rev-parse 'FETCH_HEAD^{tree}')" = "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$name")" = healthy
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
curid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")"
oldref="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$name")"
test "$oldref" = libral-vault-libral-vault -o "$oldref" = libral-vault-libral-vault:latest
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$oldref")" = "$curid"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$name")" = libral-vault
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}' "$name")" = "$root"
token=/home/admin1/.config/libral-vault/ai-core-token
check_provider() {
 python3 - "$token" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys,urllib.request,urllib.error
t=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().strip()
assert len(t)>=24
base='http://127.0.0.1:8791/internal/v1'
def req(path,body=None):
 h={'Authorization':'Bearer '+t}
 data=None
 if body is not None:
  h['Content-Type']='application/json';data=json.dumps(body).encode()
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+path,headers=h,data=data),timeout=25) as r:return r.status,json.load(r)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
  try:return e.code,json.load(e)
  except Exception:return e.code,{}
s,_=req('/health');assert s==200
basebody={'consumer':'ai-core','secret_id':'openrouter-api-key','url':'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key','method':'GET','secret_header':'authorization','secret_prefix':'Bearer '}
s,d=req('/actions/http',{**basebody,'consumer':'astera-app-api'});assert s==403 and d.get('error',{}).get('code')=='CONSUMER_IMPERSONATION_DENIED'
s,d=req('/actions/http',{**basebody,'url':'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/user'});assert s==403
s,d=req('/actions/http',basebody)
print('VAULT_AI_CORE_HEALTH=PASS IMPERSONATION_DENIED=PASS OTHER_PROVIDER_DENIED=PASS')
if s!=200:
 print('OPENROUTER_VAULT_HTTP='+str(s)+' CODE='+str(d.get('error',{}).get('code','UNKNOWN')));sys.exit(1)
p=d.get('provider',{})
print('OPENROUTER_KEY_HTTP='+str(p.get('status')))
if p.get('status')!=200:sys.exit(1)
k=json.loads(p['body']).get('data',{})
summary={x:k.get(x) for x in ('limit','limit_remaining','usage','limit_reset','is_free_tier')}
print('OPENROUTER_KEY_METADATA='+json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
assert type(k.get('limit')) in (int,float) and 0<k['limit']<=10
assert k.get('limit_reset') in (None,'none')
print('OPENROUTER_KEY_AUTH_AND_LIMIT=PASS')
PY
}
if [ "$curid" = "$newid" ]; then
 echo VAULT_ALREADY_DEPLOYED
 check_provider
 exit
fi
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$name")" = "$root/docker-compose.yml"
test "$(id -u)" = 1000
test -d "$(dirname "$token")"
python3 - "$token" <<'PY'
import os,stat,secrets,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
if not p.exists():
 fd=os.open(p,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:f.write(secrets.token_urlsafe(48)+'\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
s=p.lstat();assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==1000 and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o600 and len(p.read_text().strip())>=24
print('DEDICATED_AI_CORE_TOKEN_PROVISIONED')
PY
oldcfg="$(mktemp)"
newcfg="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$oldcfg" "$newcfg"' EXIT
docker compose -p libral-vault -f "$root/docker-compose.yml" --project-directory "$root" config --format json > "$oldcfg"
docker compose -p libral-vault -f "$p/docker-compose.yml" --project-directory "$root" config --format json > "$newcfg"
python3 - "$oldcfg" "$newcfg" "$root" "$p" <<'PY'
import sys,json
o=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));n=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
a=o['services']['libral-vault'];b=n['services']['libral-vault']
# Build source context may resolve to the explicit project directory; the
# deployed image itself is already built and pinned above.
a.pop('build',None);b.pop('build',None)
assert b['environment'].pop('LIBRAL_VAULT_AI_CORE_TOKEN_FILE')=='/run/secrets/ai-core-token'
v=b['environment']['LIBRAL_VAULT_HTTP_ALLOWLIST'].split(',')
assert v[-1]=='https://openrouter.ai'
b['environment']['LIBRAL_VAULT_HTTP_ALLOWLIST']=','.join(v[:-1])
m=[x for x in b['volumes'] if x.get('target')=='/run/secrets/ai-core-token'];assert len(m)==1 and m[0].get('source')=='/home/admin1/.config/libral-vault/ai-core-token' and m[0].get('read_only') is True
b['volumes'].remove(m[0])
assert o==n
print('VAULT_COMPOSE_DELTA_ONLY_APPROVED_PROVIDER_AND_CALLER=PASS')
PY
if docker image inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$backup")" = "$curid"
else
 docker image tag "$curid" "$backup"
fi
phase=activation
rollback() {
 rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e
 echo "VAULT_ACTIVATION_FAILED_EXIT=$rc"
 docker image tag "$backup" "$oldref"
 docker compose -p libral-vault -f "$root/docker-compose.yml" --project-directory "$root" up -d --no-build --pull never --force-recreate libral-vault
 for k in $(seq 1 30); do
  if [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = healthy ]; then echo VAULT_ROLLBACK_HEALTH=PASS;break;fi
  sleep 2
 done
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
docker image tag "$candidate" "$oldref"
docker compose -p libral-vault -f "$p/docker-compose.yml" --project-directory "$root" up -d --no-build --pull never --force-recreate libral-vault
ready=NO
for k in $(seq 1 30); do
 if [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = healthy ]; then ready=YES;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = YES
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$newid"
docker exec "$name" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const x=process.env.LIBRAL_VAULT_AI_CORE_TOKEN_FILE;if(x!=="/run/secrets/ai-core-token"||fs.readFileSync(x,"utf8").trim().length<24||!process.env.LIBRAL_VAULT_HTTP_ALLOWLIST.split(",").includes("https://openrouter.ai"))process.exit(2);console.log("VAULT_SOURCE_CONFIG_READBACK=PASS")'
trap - ERR
echo VAULT_OPENROUTER_ACTIVATION=PASS
check_provider
